name: usage-panel
description: A side panel that shows usage in color: the context window by category, the plan's rate-limit windows, this session's cost and tokens, this computer's totals for today, 7 and 30 days, and tool and MCP calls. /meter opens it.

auto_open.title: Open the panel when a session starts
auto_open.description: Off: the panel opens only when you run /meter.

mcp_names.title: Names for MCP connectors
mcp_names.description: Connectors show up by id. Give them names, one per entry, as id=Name. The first 8 characters of the id are enough, for example 1a2b3c4d=Attio.
